blocks.text: Central Abbotsford Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Central Abbotsford is the older middle of the city, around Mill Lake, South Fraser Way, Bevan Avenue and Gladwin Road. Two adopted neighbourhood plans cover its core: the City Centre Neighbourhood Plan and the Historic Downtown Neighbourhood Plan.
Abbotsford Middle School, at 33231 Bevan Avenue, and Abbotsford Senior Secondary, at 33355 Bevan Avenue, sit side by side in the centre.
Godson Elementary, at 33130 Bevan Avenue, is the central elementary on the same Bevan Avenue corridor.

blocks.text: Central Abbotsford Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Central detached houses are the city's older stock, on the established streets around Mill Lake and Bevan Avenue, rather than in a new subdivision. Centennial Park Elementary, at 2527 Gladwin Road, marks the Gladwin Road side of that older grid (address from the provincial school list).
The Historic Downtown plan area holds the oldest house streets, next to the downtown commercial core. The City's Historic Downtown Neighbourhood Plan final event boards describe that plan area.

blocks.text: Central Abbotsford Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A central house can sit in a heritage-sensitive downtown plan area. The Historic Downtown Neighbourhood Plan (Bylaw 2920-2019) is the adopted plan for the downtown core, listed by the City with its other neighbourhood plans.

A central house can also sit in the City Centre plan area, under the City Centre Neighbourhood Plan (Bylaw 2913-2019). A rebuild or added unit has to fit the plan that covers the lot, so confirm which plan area the address is in before designing.
Central lots are where that infill permission is most often used, because the lots are already serviced.
The Gur Sikh Temple area carries a heritage listing: the temple on South Fraser Way is a National Historic Site of Canada, designated by Parks Canada.

blocks.text: Central Abbotsford Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Abbotsford Traditional School (middle and secondary) is at 2272 Windsor Street, in the central area. Its registration page covers the Abbotsford Traditional Middle School intake.
The city's hospital is on the central-east side: Abbotsford Regional Hospital and Cancer Centre, listed by Fraser Health.
Fraser Health also lists an Urgent and Primary Care Centre in Abbotsford, separate from the hospital emergency department.
Mill Lake Park is the central park anchor; the City's parks and playgrounds index lists the city's park inventory for a street-level check.

blocks.text: Central Abbotsford Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Mahogany at Mill Lake, Mill Lake area, builder Ventana Construction: a multi-family residential project at Mill Lake carried on the builder's own project page.
Montvue mixed-use development, central Abbotsford, architect Keystone Architecture: a mixed-use project carried on the architect's own project page.

blocks.text: Central Abbotsford Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Central houses pay the city-wide Tax Rates Bylaw — Bylaw No. 3643-2025 for 2025, per $1,000 of taxable value.

A downtown-area house can also carry a Business Improvement Area (BIA) levy context: the City's 2025 tax report states Abbotsford Downtown Business Improvement Area taxes are calculated as part of the annual tax rates work. That levy applies to the BIA's own properties, so check the tax notice for the specific lot rather than assuming it.
2026 city-wide utility rates apply from March 1, 2026: water $1.46 per cubic metre, sewer $1.35 per cubic metre.

blocks.text: Central Abbotsford Houses: getting around

items.t: Routes 1 and 2 are the central crosstown buses: Highstreet / University of the Fraser Valley (UFV) and Highstreet / McMillan in BC Transit's Central Fraser Valley list.
Route 12 (UFV / Bourquin) is a peak-only commuter route in that same route list, linking the University of the Fraser Valley campus with the Bourquin exchange — check current.
South Fraser Way is the central east–west road, carrying the Bevan Avenue, Gladwin Road and Mill Lake house streets to Highway 11 and Highway 1.

blocks.text: Central Abbotsford Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check heritage status before planning work on a downtown-edge house.
Check creek and stormwater layers around Mill Lake on City WebMap; a central lot is not in the prairie dike area, but creek setbacks can still apply.
Check the Natural Environment Development Permit (NEDP) guide where a central lot touches a watercourse.
Check older-house servicing on the title and permit record, not on the listing: central houses predate current code, and the City WebMap does not show permit history.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Central Abbotsford

The heart of the city is Central Abbotsford. Older houses on Mill Lake and Bevan Avenue streets surround the City Centre and Historic Downtown plan areas, and most of Abbotsford’s attached housing is here.
Central Abbotsford home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

77 houses sold in Central Abbotsford with a median price of $980,000 (the middle half sold between $895,000 and $1,115,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $400 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 7,282 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 79 houses listed in Central Abbotsford. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Abbotsford a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Central Abbotsford had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Central Abbotsford from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 33 houses sold in Central Abbotsford over those 5 months, out of 287 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Is a central Abbotsford house in a heritage area?
faq.a: Some are, near the historic downtown core, and the plan is the first check. The Historic Downtown Neighbourhood Plan (Bylaw 2920-2019) covers the downtown area, and the City also keeps a Community Heritage Register. A heritage listing or a plan rule can limit demolition and exterior changes, so check the register and the plan for the exact address before planning a teardown.

faq.q: Which middle school serves a Bevan Avenue house?
faq.a: Abbotsford Middle School is the central middle school, at 33231 Bevan Avenue, beside Abbotsford Senior Secondary at 33355 Bevan Avenue. Catchment still goes by exact street address in Abbotsford School District No. 34 (SD34), so run the address through the SD34 School Locator rather than assuming the nearest school is the catchment school.

faq.q: Can I add a suite to an older central house?
faq.a: Older central houses still need building-code, parking and servicing checks, and a house in the Historic Downtown plan area can face added plan rules, so confirm both before an offer.

faq.q: Is a central house in the flood zone?
faq.a: Central Abbotsford is on the bench above the prairie floor, not behind the Sumas dike. The City's flood response pages cover the Sumas and Matsqui prairie areas; a Mill Lake–area lot is checked instead for creek and stormwater layers on City WebMap. Do not carry a prairie flood assumption into a central offer, and do not skip the parcel check either.

faq.q: What did houses in Central Abbotsford sell for?
faq.a: 77 houses sold in Central Abbotsford between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $980,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
